hook: Play Star Catch while its program runs beside it one highlighted line at a time. Every variable is a labeled box: catch a star and watch a new value fly into score, take a rock and lives drops, let ten seconds pass and speed goes up, while goal never moves.
outcome: Identify which values in a program are stored and stay the same and which ones change, and what makes them change
sources: CSTA K-12 Computer Science Standards, 2026 PK-12 identifier E3-PRO-VD-06: https://csteachers.org/k12standards/
CSTA K-12 Computer Science Standards (2017), 1B-AP-09, create programs that use variables to store and modify data: https://csteachers.org/k12standards/
Scratch Wiki, Variable (set and change blocks; a variable holds one value at a time): https://en.scratch-wiki.info/wiki/Variable
Star Catch, its program, game numbers and Lab questions are original to Curio Class
Night sky, lanes, stars, variable boxes, banners, chart and bins drawn in code; sounds generated in the browser
Desert backdrop, ship and rock drawn with GPT Image (OpenAI) via Codex
Narration generated with Qwen3-TTS (Apache 2.0), cloning a Google Gemini text-to-speech voice
